fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.text: Per the original rule book, the hero earns experience for solving puzzles, achieving goals and killing monsters, and gains hit points automatically at each new level. fullRow.text: How do I use Combat movement?
fullRow.rendered: Not in this guide — from outside research: In the original rule book's default mouse mode you move by holding the right mouse button so the hero walks toward the arrow cursor, and the left button is the action button for talking, attacking and opening things. fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.title: Hit points and healing
fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.text: In the original rule book, hit points are shown by the red health bar at the top of the screen; at zero the hero dies and you must start a new game or load a saved one. Health comes back by drinking a healing potion or visiting places where healing is available, and the maximum only goes up by gaining a level. View Stats in the menu shows the numeric maximum.

fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.title: Gold and gems
aliases: how much is a gem worth
fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.text: The original rule book names gold and gems as the two currencies, with one gem worth about ten gold pieces. Most merchants prefer gold, some accept gems and a few require them. Gold and gems mostly come from looting monster lairs and from being paid for completing tasks.

fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.title: Potion and oil effects in the rule book
aliases: potion effects in the rule book
how much does a healing potion heal
how many hit points does a healing potion restore
fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.text: The original rule book lists the Healing potion as restoring 4 to 10 hit points and the Extra Healing potion as restoring 6 to 27. A Giant Strength potion adds 8 damage to each blow for a few minutes, and the oils of elemental invulnerability (air, earth, fire, water) briefly make you immune to damage from that type of elemental. Potions are single-use and last for different real-time durations, and drinking a second one while another is active cancels the first; this guide's shop descriptions word some of these effects differently.

fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.title: Unlocking new sword moves
aliases: how do i get new sword moves
how do i unlock new swings
fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.text: According to the original rule book, the hero learns two additional sword swings as he gains experience levels and trains with the Weapons Master: the second also hits to the left and right, and the third is a 360-degree swing that also hits behind. When he becomes eligible you must guide him to the Weapons Master, who trains him quickly, and the next action circle lights up once the swing is available.

fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.title: Ghoul
fullAuthorizedSourceWitnesses.text: In the original rule book's bestiary the ghoul is an undead scavenger that often appears in packs, and its claws can paralyse a target for a short time. A person killed by ghouls becomes a ghoul unless the body is consumed.
